summary: Frontend-only regression PASS on mobile viewport 390x844 against https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. All 3 NEW features verified end-to-end plus regressions. (1) NEW WEEKEND DIMMING SCHEDULE (Device tab): enabling 'Night Dimming' reveals weekday From/To steppers + 'Dim to' slider, and now also reveals a 'Separate weekend schedule' toggle. Enabling that reveals the caption 'Used on Saturdays & Sundays.' plus a SECOND pair of From/To hour steppers (default 11 PM / 8 AM) and a SECOND 'Dim to' slider (default 20%, max 80). Confirmed: weekend startHour +1 changed 23->0 in storage; weekend endHour +1 changed 8->9; weekend Dim-to slider dragged to ~60% updated storage to weekend.dimLevel=60; weekday slider still works independently (30%). After a full page reload, storage snapshot is {enabled:true, startHour:22, endHour:7, dimLevel:30, weekend:{enabled:true, startHour:23, endHour:8, dimLevel:60}} and the UI shows 80% / 30% / 60% correctly. All values persist under aura_settings_v1 nightMode.weekend. (2) NEW LANDING ALERT (Flights tab): enabling 'Track a Specific Flight' > 'Follow one flight' now reveals a 'Landing alert' toggle below the callsign input with helper text 'Flash the matrix when this flight starts descending or lands.'. Default landingAlert=true; toggling OFF sets storage flights.landingAlert=false; after full reload the switch reads unchecked (aria-checked/checked=false) and trackFlight remains true -- both persist correctly. (3) NEW SPORTS TEAM SCORE COLORS: selecting three NFL teams (Chiefs, Cowboys, Ravens) renders 3 rotation rows without any crash / red-screen. ESPN scoreboard fetches fail with CORS on the web preview (expected per app owner) so no green/red tint is applied -- rows fall back to the plain 'NFL · KC|DAL|BAL' text without throwing. The outcomeColor null-guard code path (sports.tsx:122-129) is safe: only applies borderLeftColor/color when outcome is truthy. REGRESSION: all 4 tabs load (Device/Flights/Sports/Weather); brightness slider persists at 80%; Night Dimming weekday steppers/slider still work; 'Follow one flight' still uppercases + sanitises callsign; Sports league row still shows all 5 pills fitting a 390px viewport; team select/deselect and X-remove still work; team logos render. NO red-screen errors, NO unhandled crashes. Deprecation warnings from prior iterations (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, React-19 element.ref from react-native-draggable-flatlist, useNativeDriver on web) still fire but are non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: matrix.tsx: hydration merges saved.nightMode with DEFAULT_SETTINGS.nightMode via a shallow spread ({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.nightMode, ...(saved.nightMode ?? {}) }). If an older AsyncStorage snapshot was saved BEFORE the weekend key existed, saved.nightMode.weekend would be undefined and the spread would leave the default weekend object in place -- good, no crash. But if a partially-corrupted snapshot has saved.nightMode.weekend as a non-object (e.g. null/string), later accesses like settings.nightMode.weekend.enabled would throw at render time. Consider a defensive `{ ...DEFAULT.weekend, ...(saved.nightMode?.weekend ?? {}) }` merge for the nested weekend key too.
matrix.tsx buildFullPayload -> nightMode.weekend shape matches buildNightPayload's shape (both spread the same fields) -- good consistency between full sync and live push.

index.tsx HourStepper has no debouncing on the +/- buttons; rapid taps fire Haptics.selectionAsync() and updateWeekend() on every tick, which in turn queues a debounced BLE livePush('night', ...). Fine, but noted for battery impact on device.

sports.tsx:106-129 the outcomeColor null-guard is correct -- borderLeftColor / borderLeftWidth / score color are only applied when outcome is truthy so a null score (CORS-blocked or pre-game) never throws.

flights.tsx: 'Landing alert' ToggleRow is placed inside the {f.trackFlight && ...} conditional; when trackFlight flips OFF the toggle is unmounted, but landingAlert stays in storage. Semantically OK because the matrix only cares about landingAlert when trackFlight is true; still worth an explicit doc comment.
matrix.tsx updateWeekend correctly deep-merges: next.nightMode.weekend = { ...prev.nightMode.weekend, ...patch }. Good.
